SearchAliases: lecturer challenged by a named teacher
Senses.Note: scripture lecturer names a lecturer whose office is explaining scriptures and treatises. The retained encounters identify the role through the lecturer’s own claim to expound the Diamond Sutra or transmit numerous books.

Occurrences.Kwic: 昔二祖大師元是箇座主
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (M/M59/M59n1540.xml). Dahui Pujue: General Discourses (大慧普覺禪師普說). Speaker: Dahui Zonggao.

Senses.Explanation: A scripture lecturer is a scripture lecturer or lecture master. Nanyang Huizhong asks one what work he does, and the lecturer answers that he lectures on the Diamond Sutra; Mazu Daoyi answers another lecturer’s question by asking what teaching the lecturer himself transmits. Dahui Zonggao recalls that Huike had formerly occupied this role before seeking Bodhidharma. The exchanges do not merely contrast two institutions. Huizhong asks about the scripture’s opening words, while Mazu presses the lecturer’s account of transmission until the lecturer cannot answer.
